title: Escape from Tarkov

custody.physical: Steam digital edition · live-service title without a physical shelf object
custody.condition: Held solely as a Steam license. Online services are required for play; no disc or boxed materials accompany this filing.

curatorNotes: Space held for curator writing on Escape from Tarkov as a Steam-edition extraction holding.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license for Escape from Tarkov. Official cover artwork is on file from Steam library art; collection photography of a physical object does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam, subject to the title’s online requirements
preservation.compatibility: Access depends on Steam custody and on Battlestate’s online services. That service layer is an additional constraint beyond ordinary digital-license risk.
preservation.concerns: Account binding, storefront change, client aging, and online-service dependency. No offline installer or physical fallback is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Steam edition dated November 15, 2025. Earlier launcher-distributed builds of Escape from Tarkov are outside this accession; the archive retains the Steam-licensed digital edition in present custody.
preservation.availability: Reachable through the archive Steam account while both the license and the title’s required services remain available.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

synopsis: Battlestate Games’ Escape from Tarkov on Steam — an extraction shooter retained as an account-bound digital holding under archive custody.
